description: Source code for the Header component in a LightningJS-based weather app frontend. Defines a 'Header' component with props for title, location, and timeFormat; manages time display and focus state; renders brand/title, clock, and location with theme-based styling; includes lifecycle methods for clock updates.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the app header, including title, clock, location, focus handling, and styling.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets the header component to focused state, showing focus ring.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Removes focus state from the header component.

methods.name: _formatTime
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string based on the specified 12h or 24h format.
